newsitem.title: USA: Ballot questions and bond referendums by state.
newsitem.headline: Ballot questions and bond referendums by state.

text.p: The following is a list of upcoming ballot initiatives and measures affecting municipal finance.
P - passed. D - defeated. NA - not available.
CALIFORNIA
June 3
D -- $225 million bond measure to repair 77 Sacramento,
Calif., schools.
D -- San Clemente, Calif., 2.5 percent utility tax.
D -- Stanton, Calif., $16.88-a-month public safety charge.
P -- Glendale Unified School District's $186 million bond
measure.
P -- ABC Unified School District's $59 million bond
measure.
P -- Monrovia Unified School District's $34 million bond
measure.
P -- Hawthorne School District's $28 million bond measure.
P -- East Whittier City School District's $20 million bond
measure.
P -- Los Angeles County Proposition E, which provides
$51.7 million to the county fire department.
P -- Los Angeles County $9 million library funding
measure, Proposition L.
P -- San Jose USD $165 million school.
P -- Santa Clara USD $145 million school district.
P -- Saratoga Union SD $40 million school.
P -- San Mateo-Foster City SD $79 million.
P -- Redwood City Elem SD $44 million.
P -- South San Francisco USD $40 million.
P -- Laguna Salada Union SD $30 million.
P -- San Carlos SD $22 million.
P -- Belmont SD $12 million.
P -- $140 million of bonds for San Francisco public schools and community colleges to fund construction and improvement projects.
P -- $48 million to renovate the San Francisco zoo.
D -- Torrance Unified School District's $80.5 million bond measure.
D -- Pomona Unified School District's $35 million bond measure.
D -- El Segundo Unified School's $24 million bond measure.
FLORIDA
June 10
--Marion County, half-cent sales tax increase for schools. Sept. 4
--Miami referendum on whether the city should be dissolved and absorbed into the Metro-Dade County government. Sept. 9
--Brevard County referendum on whether to refund controversial 1989 COPs issue.
GEORGIA
June 17
--Oglethorpe County, five-year extension of special purpose one-cent sales tax increase.
LOUISIANA
July 19
--Lafayette City-Parish votes on $222 million of capital improvement bonds for streets, drainage and recreation.
NEW JERSEY
June 24
--$6 million Ridgefield Park, N.J., school bonds to renovate and expand Lincoln School. Oct. 7
--$5.75 million Cresskill, N.J., school bonds to renovate two elementary schools.
NORTH CAROLINA
June 24
--$75 million of City of Winston-Salem GO bonds for streets, parks, housing and economic development. Oct. 7
--$98 million Cumberland County school GO bonds.
MISSOURI
August 5
--$600,000 New Franklin GO bonds.
PENNSYLVANIA
Nov. 4
--Statewide referendum on a "homestead exemption" constitutional amendment, which would allow local governments to exempt homeowners from the property tax.
--Allegheny County, Pa., voters decide ballot question that would change county government from a three-member committee to a government comprised of an executive and unpaid county council.
SOUTH DAKOTA
June 24
--$2.3 million Keystone, GOs.
VIRGINIA
Nov. 4
--$73.3 million Loudoun County school bond issue for school contruction and renovations.
WEST VIRGINIA
Sept. 27
--Statewide referendum on constitutional amendment allowing equity investment of public funds. Nov. 15
--$98 million of Kanawha County school GOs.
--Renewal of Kanawha County excess levy to raise $9.93 million a year for bus and ambulance services.
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
